metadata.title: Country Duo Portrait with Arched Slab Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A dual-subject portrait featuring two men cropped at the edges with a central arched slab-serif title overlaying their chests.
excludeWhen: modern neon or high-tech aesthetics are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, symmetrical composition featuring two male subjects positioned at the extreme left and right edges, partially cropped. The background is a warm, textured sepia-toned wall. A bold, white, arched slab-serif title is centered in the lower third, bridging the gap between the two figures.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical framing of two subjects at the edges
Warm sepia background contrasting with dark clothing
Arched typography following the curve of the subjects' shoulders
Direct gaze from the subjects towards the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects at 1:1 scale relative to each other, positioned at the left and right margins, cropped vertically through the outer half of their heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white arched text in the bottom center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the left subject's face to the right subject's face, then drop down to the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central vertical corridor between the two heads provides space for the background texture and light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the black clothing and white text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochrome

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with condensed proportions
letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline and cap height for the top line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are vertically stretched to fit the arch
Slight distressing or 'weathered' texture on the fill
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both lines with varied warping.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky serifs.
Classic western feel with strong slab serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of two men in black shirts, one wearing a black cowboy hat, positioned at the far left and right edges of the frame against a textured tan wall. Leave the center bottom area clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white, bold, condensed slab-serif text in all caps. The top line should be arched upwards; the bottom line should be straight or slightly arched to match.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects cropped at the edges?
Is the color palette warm and sepia-toned?
Is the font a heavy slab serif?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific band names or logos
Ensure the faces are generic and not recognizable celebrities
recipe.reuseFormula: Two-subject edge-crop portrait + Arched slab-serif center overlay + Sepia texture.
